summary: Iteration 65 — verified the new Showroom-layout Insurance Claim DETAIL screen end-to-end on the Expo web preview (390x844). Login as ryan@ryan.com → Vault tab → Insurance Claims → switch to Closed tab → open the seeded claim 'Truck Break-In — Stolen Tools' (id 74f1e3f0-8e08-4f82-bdde-d3d389153293). The new detail loaded cleanly: IndustrialBanner title, ProgressPill at 43%, glossy 2-column header facts (STATUS:Paid · DATE OPENED 5/6/2026 · DATE SUBMITTED 5/7/2026 · CLAIM AMOUNT $1,219.00 · DEDUCTIBLE $250.00 · PAYOUT $849.00), 'Tasks to Complete' link with badge 7, and horizontal tab bar with counter badges in spec order: Details · Financials · Contacts (0) · Evidence (1) · Documents (0) · Notes (2) · Claimed Items (2) · Reports (0) · Insurance Info · Timeline (7). ZERO pageerrors, ZERO red screens across the full sweep. Tab switching verified: Details (claim # CLM-2025-04417, type Theft, address, police #), Notes (2 notes rendered with label/date/body), Claimed Items (2 items + 'No warnings' badge + + Attach), Reports (Create New / Quick Report / Email Report to Insurer buttons + empty history), Evidence (thumbnail with date), Insurance Info (Acme Mutual Insurance + Linda Park + Robert Hale + portal URL). The single skinned panel correctly swaps content per tab (never remounts) and the in-panel search bar persists across tabs. Constant in-panel search verified: typed 'Acme' → returned 'Insurance Info — Company: Acme Mutual Insurance' result row. FAB is context-aware: on Notes tab the + FAB opened the Add Note modal directly (Label dropdown 'General', Note field, 'Create a task from this note' toggle, Add Note button); on Contacts tab the + FAB opened the Add Contact modal (Name/Role/Phone/Email/Address/Note + Add Contact button). One minor UX finding: the 'Tasks to Complete' header link did NOT open the task list sheet when tapped — the in-app TouchableOpacity onPress did not fire on web (Playwright click on the link did not trigger setTaskListOpen(true)); the Tasks sheet IS reachable via FAB → Add → Task, but the header link itself appears unresponsive on the web preview. Touch target also measures only ~115×15 px (well below the 44pt HIG minimum). No backend testing performed per request (frontend-only).

critical_code_review_comments: app/insurance-claims/[id].tsx (1214 lines) — single file is well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting per-tab renderers (renderDetails / renderFinancials / renderContacts / ... / renderTimeline) into individual files under src/components/insurance/tabs/ and move the modal forms (ContactModal, NoteModal, TaskModal, DocumentModal, ReportModal, EmailModal, ItemEditModal, EvidenceViewer) into their own files. Will improve maintainability and reduce risk of remount churn.

ShowroomPanel is correctly hoisted to module scope (line 67) so it never remounts on tab change — this matches the spec and was confirmed visually (the panel frame & search bar stay constant while content swaps).

Global search builder (buildSearchResults, line 757) is comprehensive — covers details, insurance, items, notes, contacts, evidence, documents, reports, timeline. Result row click correctly jumps to the originating tab via setTab(r.tab). Good coverage of the spec's 'searches every field' requirement.
Progress %% appears to blend the 7 fixed steps with task completion as the spec confirmed (claim showed 43% with 7 open tasks pending) — implementation matches decision #1 in the spec.

rca_of_issue: Tasks-to-Complete header link is a Text node inside a TouchableOpacity (lines 592–596). On react-native-web, TouchableOpacity becomes a div with role=button, but the inner Text element is what get_by_text matched. The click did register on the div but the onPress callback didn't run — most likely because the row sits underneath the ScrollView/tabBar absolute layer or the parent ProgressPill is intercepting pointer events. Recommend wrapping the link with a Pressable, giving it an explicit testID (e.g. 'icd-tasks-link'), adding hitSlop, and verifying no sibling has zIndex/pointerEvents=auto over it. Once instrumented, retest with [data-testid="icd-tasks-link"].
